text: Evening. I'll try to give you everything in one go. My son is 1 month old, born at term, and tonight I think he has a temperature. I took it under his arm with our digital thermometer about twenty minutes ago and it read 38.8°C. I wasn't sure I'd done it right so I waited a few minutes and did it again and got 38.8 again, so I'm fairly confident it's accurate, though I suppose it could be off a bit. It seems to have started at some point this evening, maybe since about 9, as he didn't feel warm when I changed him earlier. My partner is asleep upstairs after a long day so I said I'd handle it and get some advice. I haven't given him anything, I wasn't sure what's allowed at his age, and I'd rather check first than guess. We're about twenty minutes by car from the hospital if that's relevant. Let me know what you'd like us to do.
